title: Conditions of Sale for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Travel Credit Terms
content:
1. Application. These conditions govern travel credit arising on a ticket sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands. They fix, for each fare brand, the calendar months a travel credit stays redeemable from its issue date, the fee to reissue a lapsed travel credit onto a new voucher, and whether a travel credit may be redeemed by someone other than the named traveller.

2. Period of redemption. A travel credit stays redeemable for the calendar months stated for the brand under which it arose, counted from its issue date.

   2.1 The period is 12 calendar months under Economy Saver and Economy Classic, 18 under Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select, and 24 under Business Saver and Business Flex.

   2.2 Basic Economy Lite states 0 months, so no travel credit stands redeemable under that brand.

3. Reissue of a lapsed credit. Where a travel credit has lapsed, the fee to reissue it onto a new voucher is the amount stated for the brand: 75.00 under Economy Saver and Economy Classic alike, 50.00 under Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select alike, 25.00 under Business Saver, and 0.00 under Business Flex and under Basic Economy Lite.

4. Redemption by another person. A travel credit may be redeemed by someone other than the named traveller under Premium Economy Select, Business Saver and Business Flex. It may not be so redeemed under Basic Economy Lite, Economy Saver, Economy Classic or Economy Flex, under which it stays with the named traveller.

5. Schedule of the quantities defined above.

| Fare brand | Months redeemable from issue date | Reissue of a lapsed credit, USD | Redeemable by another person |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0 | 0.00 | not permitted |
| Economy Saver | 12 | 75.00 | not permitted |
| Economy Classic | 12 | 75.00 | not permitted |
| Economy Flex | 18 | 50.00 | not permitted |
| Premium Economy Select | 18 | 50.00 | permitted |
| Business Saver | 24 | 25.00 | permitted |
| Business Flex | 24 | 0.00 | permitted |
